qualityBar.verdict: Battle Drones gives friends a browser RTS they can join by link, complete with scouting, harvesting and a base to defend.

installSteps.text: Open the official Battle Drones game page in a modern browser.
Start a solo match to learn movement, selection and construction.
For two players, start an online duel and send the guest its invite link.
For a four-player battle, share a different seat link with each guest.
Leave the host tab open while everyone plays.

faq.q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a: Open the free browser game directly.
Yes. The AI commander plays under fog of war and manages its own army.

faq.q: How do I invite a friend?
faq.a: Use the online duel invite link or QR code from the game.
Yes. Give each player the link for their own seat in the free-for-all lobby.
Online play uses the relay. The separate sound duel mode uses audio between nearby devices.

Yes. Battle Drones supports up to 4 players. Its multiplayer runs through the game's own online service or menus, so PlayBound Connect parties and PlayBound dedicated servers are not available for it.

min.notes: Runs in a modern browser with working graphics and network access. The developer publishes no numeric CPU, GPU or RAM minimum. Online matches require connectivity; the host browser must remain active.

recommended.notes: No separate recommended hardware tier has been published.

qualityBar.verdict: Battle Drones gives friends a browser RTS they can join by link, complete with scouting, harvesting and a base to defend.

installSteps.text: Open Simon Willison's official Battle Drones page in a modern browser. There is no desktop installer or game file to download.
Keep the host's browser tab active during an online match. Every other player opens their own invite link in a separate browser.

firstPlaySteps.text: Start a solo skirmish to learn unit selection, harvesting and base construction before inviting a rival.

multiplayerGamingSteps.text: For a duel, choose Duel a friend online on the Skirmish tab and send its invite URL or QR code to the second player.
For up to four players, choose the Compass Rose map and Battle friends online. Give each guest a different seat link; the host starts the match and keeps the browser open.

faq.q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a: No. Open Simon Willison's free browser game directly on a compatible device.
Yes. You can play against an AI commander under fog of war.

faq.q: How do I invite a friend?
faq.a: Start an online duel from the Skirmish tab and send its invite link or QR code.
Yes. On Compass Rose, give each guest a different seat link in the free-for-all lobby.
No. Ordinary online matches use the game's relay. Its separate nearby sound-duel mode uses audio between devices.
The developer documents touch and browser input, but PlayBound has not verified a physical-controller mode or Controls profile.

faq.q: Can PlayBound host a dedicated server for it?
faq.a: No. The host's own browser runs the match and the game's relay carries orders. There is no dedicated server package for PlayBound Hosting.
